about: Pinned inputs and expected strings of the items checks (LEARN.md §11.5 ITM-1…12) on the first case, sln-find-metastasis on CAMELYON16 tumor_014 (Appendix A; owner defaults of 2026-11-04 applied, default pending owner). Coordinates are level-0 px of the 15,360 px region; scales are µm per CSS px. The scoring numbers are LEARN.md §6 (pinned by the scoring module in harness/fixtures/learn/scoring/case1.json); this file only names what the items checks place and expect to read.

expect.refuseN: Answer this item first: commit, then reveal (U).
expect.gateNoMark: Not met yet · place a mark, then view it at 20×
expect.gateBestP7: Not met yet · highest magnification over your mark so far: 5×
expect.saved: Answer saved. You can still change it until you reveal. Press U to reveal.
expect.saidInside: Revealed. Your point is inside the outline. 1 of 1.
expect.polygonClosed: Polygon closed. Commit answer has focus. Press Enter again to commit, or Escape to go back to the slide.
expect.pointPlaced: Point placed. Commit answer has focus. Press Enter again to commit, or Escape to go back to the slide.
expect.gateWarnSpoken: You have not viewed your mark at 20 times yet. Commit now for half credit if it is correct, or press 5 to jump to 20 times first.
expect.halfGate: Correct region, but you never viewed it at 20×: half credit by the gate rule stated on the card.
expect.unlocked: Answer unlocked. Change your mark or confidence, then commit again.
expect.ruleLine: Scored: a point on any tumour focus (or within 50 µm of one), or an outline of the largest deposit with IoU 0.50 or more; an outline that lies at least 90 % on tumour earns half credit.
